- Can you confirm the remit address you want on invoices (physical address vs. billing email)? If you accept electronic invoices, please confirm preferred AP email and an ACH/Intl bank verification doc (we'll keep the banking details private in Finance).
- Please return the completed procurement onboarding form (attached) and a current W-9 (or W-8BEN if applicable). If there are any parent/subsidiary relationships we should be aware of, include that too.

Next steps from our side once we have confirmation: map vendor to preferred PO legal name, set tax jurisdiction, and confirm remittance routing. If you prefer, we can issue the first PO to the legal name and add the DBA in the system.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our Ops partner has an impending PO for prototype supplies.
